title: Cross-Talk & Stand-Up Comedy Show
summary: Adelaide Senior Learning Centre partnered with the City of Adelaide to present a cross-talk (相声) and stand-up comedy performance for the community.
content:
Adelaide Senior Learning Centre, in partnership with the Adelaide City Council, presented a wonderful cross-talk and stand-up comedy event that brought laughter and joy to the community.

Our members showcased their talent in traditional Chinese cross-talk and modern stand-up comedy, entertaining a full house. The event was a celebration of humour, culture and community connection.

Thank you to everyone who attended and performed — your energy made this a truly memorable afternoon!

title: Choir Performance Invited by Elizabeth City Council
summary: Our choir was honoured to perform at a community event hosted by the City of Elizabeth, showcasing the talents of our senior members.
content:
We are proud to share that our choir was invited by the City of Elizabeth to perform at a community event. Our members delivered a powerful choral performance that was warmly received by the audience.

This invitation from the Elizabeth City Council is a wonderful recognition of our members' talent and dedication. It also reflects the growing reputation of Adelaide Senior Learning Centre as a vibrant community organisation contributing to multicultural community events across South Australia.

Congratulations to all choir members and their conductor!

title: Tai Chi Promotion at Marion Council
summary: Our Tai Chi group was invited by the City of Marion to demonstrate and promote Tai Chi as part of community health and wellness initiatives.
content:
Our Tai Chi group had the honour of being invited by the City of Marion to promote Tai Chi at a community event. Members demonstrated the graceful movements and health benefits of this traditional Chinese practice.

Tai Chi is one of our most popular programs, helping seniors improve balance, flexibility and mental wellbeing. The Marion community showed great interest, and many attendees signed up to learn more about our programs.

We look forward to continuing our collaboration with the City of Marion in promoting healthy ageing through traditional wellness practices.

title: Road Safety Awareness Event
summary: Adelaide Senior Learning Centre hosted a road safety awareness session for seniors, covering pedestrian safety, public transport tips and safe driving practices.
content:
We hosted a Road Safety Awareness event for our members, aimed at promoting safe mobility for seniors in the community.

The session covered practical tips on pedestrian safety, using public transport confidently, and safe driving practices for older adults. The event was well attended and sparked many useful discussions among members.

Thank you to everyone who participated and shared their experiences. Stay safe, stay mobile!

title: Community Fishing Trip
summary: Members enjoyed a relaxing outdoor fishing trip — a wonderful opportunity to connect with nature and each other.
content:
Our members headed outdoors for a community fishing trip — a relaxing day by the water, enjoying fresh air, good company and the simple joy of fishing.

Events like this are an important part of our social connection programs. Spending time outdoors, learning new skills and sharing stories with friends all contribute to healthy ageing and wellbeing.

Whether it was their first time fishing or they were seasoned anglers, everyone had a wonderful time. More outdoor activities are being planned — stay tuned!

title: AI Video Editing & Recognition Workshop
summary: A new workshop introduced members to AI-powered video editing tools and image recognition technology for short-form content creation.
content:
We launched a new workshop on AI-powered video editing and image recognition technology. Members learned how to use AI tools to edit short videos, add effects, and organise photos automatically.

This workshop is part of our ongoing digital literacy program, helping seniors stay up to date with modern technology. The response was fantastic — members were amazed at how easy AI tools make video creation!

More AI workshops are planned. No prior experience needed — just bring your smartphone!

title: Photography & Smartphone AI Workshop
summary: A hands-on workshop teaching smartphone photography techniques and AI-powered editing tools for seniors.
content:
Our Photography and AI for Smartphones workshop was a hit! Members learned how to take better photos using their phones, and explored AI-powered editing tools that make photo enhancement easy.

From composition basics to one-tap AI enhancements, participants gained practical skills they can use every day to capture and share special moments.

This workshop reflects our commitment to digital inclusion — ensuring seniors have the skills and confidence to use modern technology.

title: Adelaide Zoo Group Outing
summary: Members enjoyed a group outing to Adelaide Zoo — a fun day of wildlife, walking and social connection.
content:
What a fantastic day at Adelaide Zoo! Our members enjoyed a group outing filled with wildlife encounters, scenic walks and wonderful company.

Group outings like this are a highlight of our social program. They provide opportunities for members to connect outside the classroom, enjoy Adelaide's attractions, and create lasting memories together.

Thank you to everyone who joined. More excursions are being planned — watch this space!

title: Supporting Men's Health in Partnership with MCCSA
summary: Adelaide Senior Learning Centre is proud to support men's health initiatives in partnership with the Multicultural Communities Council of South Australia (MCCSA).
content:
Adelaide Senior Learning Centre is proud to support men's health initiatives in partnership with the Multicultural Communities Council of South Australia (MCCSA).

We believe that healthy ageing involves not only physical wellbeing, but also mental health, social connection and active community participation. Through community education, health promotion and collaborative events, we aim to encourage older adults to stay informed, connected and engaged.

We sincerely thank MCCSA for their ongoing collaboration and look forward to working together on future community health and wellbeing initiatives.

title: Term 3 Enrolments Now Open
summary: New semester commenced mid-July. New students welcome — come try a class for free! Over 383 registered members and growing.
content:
Term 3 has officially begun! Our new semester runs from mid-July to late September, aligned with the SA public school calendar.

We're thrilled to welcome both returning and new members. With over 383 registered members, our community continues to grow rapidly.

New this term: Senior Fitness program with Ms. Lina, and expanded Smartphone Classes.

Not sure which class to join? You're welcome to attend a trial session — just contact us via WeChat or fill in the enrolment form.

title: Senior Fitness Program Launch
summary: Introducing our new gentle exercise program with Ms. Lina — focused on stretching, mobility, and fall prevention for seniors.
content:
We're excited to launch our brand new Senior Fitness program, led by the wonderful Ms. Lina.

This gentle exercise program is specifically designed for older adults, focusing on:

  • Stretching and flexibility
  • Mobility improvement
  • Fall prevention techniques
  • Balance training

No prior fitness experience needed — all movements are adapted to individual abilities. Join us and stay active in a safe, supportive environment!

title: Mid-Autumn Festival Preparation
summary: Planning underway for our annual Mid-Autumn celebration. Performers and volunteers wanted — sign up now!
content:
Preparations are in full swing for our annual Mid-Autumn Festival celebration — one of the biggest events on our calendar!

We're looking for:

  • Performers (dance, music, poetry)
  • Event volunteers (setup, food, photography)
  • Mooncake donations and sponsors

This is always a highlight of the year — a wonderful opportunity to celebrate Chinese culture with our community. Contact us on WeChat to get involved!

title: End of Term 2 Celebrations
summary: Thank you to all students and instructors for a wonderful Term 2. Over 180 members attended the end-of-term gathering at 168 South Terrace.
content:
Term 2 concluded with a fantastic celebration at our 168 South Terrace venue. Over 180 members attended — our biggest end-of-term gathering yet!

Highlights included:

  • Vocal and Hulusi student performances
  • Photo slideshow of term highlights
  • Shared lunch and tea
  • Recognition of volunteer contributions

Thank you to every student, instructor, and volunteer who made Term 2 so special. We'll see you after the break!

title: New Photography Class Added
summary: We've introduced a photography class on Tuesdays with Mr. Xu Jiashu. All skill levels welcome — bring your camera or smartphone!
content:
Say cheese! We're delighted to introduce our newest program: Photography with Mr. Xu Jiashu.

This class is designed for absolute beginners through to hobbyists who want to improve their skills. Mr. Xu covers:

  • Camera and smartphone photography basics
  • Composition and lighting
  • Portrait and landscape techniques
  • Basic photo editing

Classes run every Tuesday 10:00–11:00 AM at 294–300 Morphett Street, Adelaide. Bring any camera — even your phone!

title: Harmony Week Performance
summary: Our dance and music groups performed at the SA Harmony Week celebrations — a proud moment for our multicultural community.
content:
What a proud moment for Adelaide Chinese Senior College! Our square dancing and vocal music groups were invited to perform at the South Australian Harmony Week celebrations.

Harmony Week is a time to celebrate Australia's cultural diversity, and our members represented the Chinese-Australian community with energy, passion and grace.

The audience loved the performances, and many attendees expressed interest in joining our programs. This is exactly the kind of community engagement and cross-cultural connection we strive for.

Well done to everyone involved!

title: Parliament House Visit
summary: Members visited South Australian Parliament House for a guided tour and meeting with local representatives.
content:
In March 2026, a group of our members visited the South Australian Parliament House for a guided tour and community engagement session.

The visit included:

  • A tour of the historic Parliament building
  • Meeting with local MPs
  • Learning about how laws are made in SA
  • Afternoon tea in the Parliamentary dining room

This was a wonderful opportunity for our members to engage with Australian democracy and civic life. We look forward to more such visits in the future!

title: Lunar New Year Celebration
summary: Over 100 members celebrated the Year of the Horse with performances, food, and festivities at 168 South Terrace.
content:
We rang in the Year of the Horse with a spectacular Lunar New Year celebration at our 168 South Terrace venue.

Over 100 members attended, enjoying:

  • Chinese dance performances
  • Hulusi and vocal music
  • Traditional New Year foods
  • Red envelope (hongbao) exchange
  • Calligraphy demonstrations

It was a joyful day of cultural celebration and community connection. Wishing everyone a healthy and prosperous Year of the Horse!
